forms.text: pito ko toki to lafak romoal kako nay-foti?

translations.text: At seven in the morning I get up from sleep.

forms.text: na-romoal tangsor miso?ats to walis marari?op kako

translations.text: Having gotten up, right away I brush my teeth and wash my face.

forms.text: ma-hřek a ma-rari?op ?i mi-sa?osi kako to fangtsar-ay a tsolal

translations.text: When I finish washing my face, I read the Bible.

forms.text: pangkiw saka-faro no toki ma-řanam kami

translations.text: At half past eight o'clock, we eat breakfast.

forms.text: anini a řomi?al ?i tayřa kako i posko

translations.text: Today I am going to Posko.

forms.text: iřa ko sa?opo no tsiwro ato sitsotsi itiřa mara-pa-pasifana?-ay kako

translations.text: There is a meeting of elders and deacons there whom I will teach.

forms.text: mahřek a mařanam mara-rosil to kako to saka-tayřa i posko

translations.text: When breakfast is finished I prepare to go to Posko.

forms.text: mimaan kiso mama saan ko wawa ako a mi-ritsay

translations.text: "What are you doing father," so asks my child.

forms.text: tayřa kako i posko han ako
ka-itini ito i roma? pi-tengir to soar ni ina haw han ako tsinřa

translations.text: "Stay here at home; obey your mother's words, O.K.?" I say to him.

forms.text: siwa ko toki mi-lakaw to kako to kasoring pa-sayřa i posko

translations.text: At nine o'clock I get on the gasoline train to go to Posko.

forms.text: tahiřa kako i posko tstsay ko safaw no toki

translations.text: I arrive in Posko at eleven (?) o'clock.

forms.text: tahiřa han ako ma-sa?opo ito ko ?aromanay a tsiwro ato sitsotsi

translations.text: When I arrived there gathered many elders and deacons.

forms.text: ripahak ko farotso? ako a ma-sasi?af̂a?ařaw to ?ařomanay a tamlaw

translations.text: My heart was happy because so many people came together.

forms.text: spot ko toki to hřek no rohok mi-lakaw htsa kako to kasoring a mi-nokay

translations.text: At four o'clock in the afternoon I get on once more the gasoline train and return.

forms.text: tahiřa han ako i roma? ma-tahkar ito ko saka-rafi

translations.text: When I arrived home food is already prepared for supper.

forms.text: ripahak ko forotso? ako anini nawhani fangtsar ko řakot ako i fatal no raran

translations.text: My heart is happy now because I had a fine trip on the way.

texts.title: Fire and Water
texts.copyright: All rights reserved; FormosanBank has permission to publish.
texts.citation: Tamih and Montgomery, Robert L. (1962) Amis text. Work Papers of the Summer Institute of Linguistics, University of North Dakota Session: Vol. 6, Article 6. 10.31356/silwp.vol06.06

forms.text: o-namar ato nanom ?i o-ngaay a maro-wilang-ay

translations.text: Now fire and water, they were good friends.

forms.text: yo-tstsay no řomial ma-tstsori tsangřa tsima ita ko kaka-rimera-an saan tsangřa

translations.text: One day they quarreled, "Who is the most important?"" This was the situation for them.

forms.text: pa-soar ko namar ano awa kako omaan ko sapi-tangtang to hmay ato lateng saan

translations.text: The fire said, "Without me, what about cooking rice and vegetables," so he said.

forms.text: pa-tsa?of ko nanom ano ma-iroh ko roma? ?i omaan ko sapi-paleng sisit han to kamay saan

translations.text: Answered water, "If the house is burning, what about extinguishing it? Are you going to rub it out with your hands?" so he said.

forms.text: nanoiya salak sato ko tsilar a somoar tsangřa-an aka-to ka-tsatsori maretsal ito a o-kaka-rimera-an kamo

translations.text: Then the sun came out and said to them, "Don't quarrel; you are equal in importance."

forms.text: ano awa ko namar ?i awa ko ?pots ano awa ko nanom ?i awa ito ko ?pots

translations.text: "If there is no fire, it is without meaning." "If there is no water, it is without meaning."

forms.text: ka-sasinga?ay ito kasasilamalama ito kamo han no tsilar tsangřa

translations.text: "Be reconciled and help one another," the sun said to them.

forms.text: itini i roma? ako iřa ko tstsay a watso ongangan niřa tsi siro

translations.text: At my home there is a dog whose name is Silo.

forms.text: ma-orah kami oporong no roma? tsingřa-an
ano tayřa kako i pi?atsa-an to lateng ?i mi-tooř t-ako-anan

translations.text: If I go to the vegetable market, he follows me.

forms.text: itini i roma? ?i maorah a mi-salrama ato wawa

translations.text: At home he likes to play with the children.
In addition he guards the house.

forms.text: itsira mi-tsakay kako to titi no fafoy

translations.text: Yesterday I bought some pig meat

forms.text: mi-nengneng tsi siro to titi no fafoy ?i ma-atsang nawhani ma-orah tsingřa to titi

translations.text: When Silo saw the pig meat, he was excited (?) because he likes meat.

forms.text: yo kemaen sato kami ?i pa-?isar hanto ako tsingřa a pafri

translations.text: When we eat (have eaten?) I set apart some to give him.

forms.text: tala-o-nga?ay-ay a wilang ako tsi siro

translations.text: Silo is my very good friend.
